content:
PR 2 landed. ClassifierClient trait + TonicClassifierClient (prod) + FixtureClassifierClient (test) all on main.

## Surface
- polaris-backend/src/classifier/{mod.rs, client.rs, error.rs}
- 7 unit tests passing (4 fixture behaviour + 1 health override + 1 feedback capture + 1 dyn-compatibility)

## Architect-run verification
- cargo build -p polaris-backend  PASS
- cargo clippy -p polaris-backend --tests -- -D warnings  CLEAN
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib classifier  7 PASSED

## Direct-authoring notes
Continuing direct-author pattern from #125 (avoids worktree-base-drift documented on #98). The trait + 2 impls pattern keeps testability without the typestate ceremony that doesn't fit a transport abstraction.

PR 3 (#127 — fan-out subscriber + observation materialisation) is now unblocked.
